content_type: tutorial/explainer talking -- calm, measured delivery, not high-energy commentary
description: Caption timing derived from a manual timing edit of a tutorial-style clip. The clip and the 30-cue reference SRT these numbers were measured against are not in this repo -- they are third-party footage and were not ours to publish -- so treat this as a recorded starting point, not a fixture you can re-verify here. Measure your own before changing the numbers.

transcription._warning: This block is DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- nothing in the pipeline reads it. The flags that actually run live in the streamer profile's `whisper` block (streamers/example.json). Kept here to record what produced the validated output.

line_grouping._note: A new caption line starts on a pause longer than pause_threshold_ms, on sentence punctuation, or when max_chars/max_words is reached. On most content max_chars and punctuation are what actually break lines -- the pause threshold rarely fires. Check before tuning it.

repeated_word_handling.note: Consecutive identical words within this gap merge into one cue -- whisper's per-word timestamps are unreliable on rapid repeats.

duration_ceiling.note: Caps a cue's length by word count so captions don't linger: cap = start + n_words*per_word_seconds + base_seconds. Applied unconditionally here. CAUTION: an aggressive ceiling is the single most common cause of bad captions -- on faster content this one truncated cues badly and left holes. If your captions cover far less than the clip, suspect this first. Set both to a large number (e.g. 99.0) to disable.

timing_bias_correction.measured_from: a manual reference edit of the same clip, ~96 words matched
timing_bias_correction.note: Whisper's timestamps ran systematically late on this content; these are the measured median offsets, applied to finished line boundaries only (not before grouping, which would distort gap detection). DO NOT copy these numbers to other content -- an unmeasured shift compresses every cue. Leave both at 0 until you have measured your own against a hand-corrected reference.

post_processing.note: No line's end may exceed the next line's start.
post_processing._spread_collapsed_note: OFF here on purpose: this profile's output, zero-length cues included, is what was measured against the manual reference edit. Turning it on changes several of those cues. See example_gameplay.json for what it does and why you probably want it on for real work.

validated_against: A manual reference edit of one tutorial-style clip -- 30 cues, ~96 words matched. Neither the clip nor the reference SRT ships with this repo (see `description`), so there is no self-test to run: validate against your own footage.
known_limitations: Rapid repeated-word stretches may merge into one longer cue rather than matching manually-split rhythm.
No silence gating -- see example_gameplay.json and docs/constraints.md.
Tuned for calm explainer delivery. Using it on fast commentary truncates cues; use a profile measured on that content instead.
